items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: You couldn’t do any better than to listen to Thelonious.

ctx.x: You couldn’t do any better than to listen to Thelonious. It seems like sometimes the simplest things are the best, you know. And I think these gentlemen certainly understood that to some extent. I would like to ask you, before we get to Alfred and his vision of Blue Note Records, you must have been a jazz fan before you met him. Is that right?
